keepEachConversationSPromptCacheOnDisk: Bomba cache ya prompt ya masolo moko na moko na disque po kofungola yango lisusu etanga lisusu masolo mobimba te. Ezongisami kaka tango modèle, ba paramètres na yango na llama.cpp build nionso ekokani na oyo ebombaki yango.
conversationCacheDiskLimitMib: Limite ya disque ya cache ya masolo (MiB) .
diskBudgetForSavedConversationCachesDefa: Budget ya disque mpo na ba caches ya masolo oyo ebombami (par défaut: 8192). Babwakaka liboso oyo ya kala soki bakómi na yango. Lisolo moko ya molai ekoki kozwa bankama ya MiB.
minChunkSizeOfMatchingPrefixTokensTo: Min taille ya chunk ya ba jetons ya préfix oyo ekokani pona kosalela lisusu depuis cache. 0 = azali na makoki ya kosala mosala.
contextCheckpoints: Ba points de contrôle ya contexte
maximumContextCheckpointsKeptPerSlotWhic: Ba points de vérification ya contexte maximale oyo ebombami na slot moko, oyo etikaka contexte oyo ebongwani ezongisama na esika ya kosala yango lisusu.
checkpointMinimumStep: Etape ya moke ya esika ya botali
minimumNumberOfTokensBetweenContextCheck: Motango ya moke ya ba jetons kati ya ba points de contrôle ya contexte.
useFullSizeKvCacheForSlidingWindow: Salelá cache ya taille mobimba KV mpo na ba modèles ya attention ya fenêtre glissante (e.g. Gemma). Activer yango soki modèle ya boye ezo reprocesser prompt mobimba chaque tour au lieu ya kosalela lisusu cache; esɛngaka mémoire mingi.
useASingleUnifiedKvBufferSharedAcross: Salelá tampon moko ya bomoko KV oyo ekabolami na bisika nyonso. Abomba mémoire tango ozali kosala ba slots parallèles ebele.
capHowMuchOfTheUnifiedKvCache: Cap boni ya cache unifié KV slot moko ekoki kosalela, na ba jetons. 0 etikaka esika moko ya ofele mpo na kotondisa cache mobimba. Esalemaka kaka tango cache ezali unifié.
keepTheReasoningOfEveryEarlierAssistantT: Bomba raisonnement ya tour nionso ya assistant ya liboso na prompt, kaka oyo ya sika te. Ezali ko affecter kaka ba modèles oyo modèle ya chat na yango e soutenir yango, pe efutaka ba jetons ya prompt.
numberOfTokensFromTheInitialPromptTo: Motango ya bilembo uta na bosengi ya ebandeli mpo na kobomba ntango contexte ebalusami. -1 = bomba nionso.
automaticallyUnloadOtherModelsWhenLoadin: Déchargement automatiquement ba modèles misusu tango ozali ko charger ya sika
accessTokensProgrammaticallyAuthenticate: Ba jetons ya accès e authentiquer programmatiquement identité na yo na Hugging Face Hub, epesaka nzela na ba applications esala ba actions spécifiques oyo elakisami na portée ya ba permissions oyo epesami.
oneOrMoreFilesExceedTheValue0Mb: Fisyé moko to mingi eleki ndelo ya {{value0}}MB
areYouSureYouWantToRevokeAccess: Ozali sûr que olingi ko revoquer accès pona appareil oyo? Esengeli kondima lisusu aparɛyi yango mpo na kokɔta na yango.
areYouSureYouWantToClearAll: Ozali sûr que olingi o effacer ba journal nionso ya accès? Action oyo ekoki kozongisama sima te.
changingTheAuthenticationModeWillAffectH: Kobongola mode ya bondimi ekozala na bopusi na lolenge nini ba clients ba accéder na instance na yo ya Novera. Ozali na ntembe te ete olingi kokoba?
pausedValue0: Pause · {{value0}}% Ezali ndenge moko na ba .
preparingServerForClaudeCode: Kobongisa serveur pona Code ya Claude
theProvidedHuggingFaceTokenIsInvalidPlea: Jeton Hugging Face oyo epesami ezali na ntina te. Svp tala token na yo pe meka lisusu.
theValidationRequestTimedOutPleaseCheckY: Bosengi ya bondimi esilaki tango. Svp tala connexion ya réseau na yo pe meka lisusu.
aNetworkErrorOccurredWhileValidatingTheT: Libunga ya réseau esalemaki tango ya ko valider jeton. Svp tala connexion internet na yo.
unknownParameters: {{count}} ba paramètres oyo eyebani te ebombami: {{names}}
maximumAllowed: Motuya ya likolo oyo epesami nzela ezali {{max}}
downloadProgressEmpty: Progrès ya téléchargement na yo ekobima awa
importModelReadme: Tala mikanda ya modèle pona licence na yango, minoko oyo esungami, mémoire oyo esengeli pe bosaleli oyo ekanamaki liboso ya téléchargement.
settingsLanguageHelp: Mbongwana ya nkota etali interface. Biyano ya modèle etali malako na yo mpe minoko oyo modèle oyo oponi esungaki.
apiFallbackHint: Fungola ya liboso ezali #1. Novera emekaka lisusu fungola oyo elandi kaka sima ya eyano ya 401, 403 to 429.
unexpectedErrorHelp: Eloko moko ekendeki mabe. Bozongisa lokasa oyo sika to benga lisungi soki mokakatano yango ezali kaka.
huggingFaceTokenValid: Hugging Face token na yo ezali malamu
keyUnauthorized: Key oyo ezali mabe to ebebisamaki (401)
keyRateLimited: Ebongisami malamu to mposo ezali pasi (429)
dependencySomeCoreBackendFilesAreMissing: Ba fichiers mosusu ya moboko ya sima ezangi to ebebi — yango elakisi mingi mingi téléchargement ekatanaki to archive elongolamaki kaka ndambo. Bolongola sima ya sima mpe bo télécharger yango lisusu na ba paramètres Novera.
dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Botia NCCL uta na NVIDIA site ya Mobongisi. NCCL esalelamaka mpo na bopanzi sango ya bato ebele GPU.
dependencyInstallNcclViaTheNvidiaPackage: Botia NCCL na nzela ya ebombelo ya paquet NVIDIA. Na Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install libnccl2 libnccl-dev. Tala NVIDIA NCCL buku ya botiami mpo na distro na yo.
dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Botia cuDNN uta na site ya NVIDIA Mokeli mpe tia ba DLL pembeni ya application to na System32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Botia cuDNN na nzela ya ebombelo ya ba paquets NVIDIA to bozwa tarball mpe ba libs ya kopi na /usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Botia Vulkan Tango ya Bosali uta na LunarG. Mokumbi na yo GPU akoki kozala na yango deja — kozongisa liboso mokumbi na yo ya GPU.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Botia mokumbi Vulkan: na Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. Na Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. Na RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkitFromNvidi: Botia CUDA Bokumbi bisaleli uta na NVIDIA. Na tango ya installation, pona ba composants "CUDA".
Botia CUDA Bokumbi bisaleli uta na NVIDIA. Na Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Na RHEL/Fedora: salela NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit11FromNvi: Botia CUDA Bokumbi bisaleli 11 uta na NVIDIA. Na tango ya installation, pona ba composants "CUDA".
Botia CUDA Bokumbi bisaleli 11 uta na NVIDIA. Na Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-11. Na RHEL/Fedora: salela NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit12FromNvi: Botia CUDA Bokumbi bisaleli 12 uta na NVIDIA. Na tango ya installation, pona ba composants "CUDA".
Botia CUDA Bokumbi bisaleli 12 uta na NVIDIA. Na Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Na RHEL/Fedora: salela NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit13FromNvi: Botia CUDA Bokumbi bisaleli 13 uta na NVIDIA. Na tango ya installation, pona ba composants "CUDA".
Botia CUDA Bokumbi bisaleli 13 uta na NVIDIA. Na Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-13. Na RHEL/Fedora: salela NVIDIA repo.
generationCountHint: Pona bilili boni, banzembo ya miziki to bavideo boni okobimisa (1–10). Eloko mokomoko esalemaka na molɔngɔ. Stop e annuler ba travaux oyo etikali.
reasoningEnabledHint: Raisonnement efungolami mpo na bosengi nyonso.
reasoningDisabledHint: Raisonnement ezali désactivé mpo na demande nionso.
